_comment: Site config. Copy to ~/.claude/harness.config.json and edit, or point CLAUDE_HARNESS_CONFIG at it. No file — generic defaults: main is protected, no company host is guarded, nothing is watched, no prod relation counts as configuration, the work-doc reminder is silent. A file that exists and does not read (broken JSON, a field of the wrong shape) makes pre-push-guard and owner-actions answer unknown/deny until it is fixed. Contract: src/config.ts.
_protectedBranches: Branches a feature branch may not push or open an MR into; only release/* and hotfix/* reach them. Default ["main"]. PREPUSH_PROTECTED / OWNER_GATE_PROTECTED (comma list) outrank it for one run.
_integrationBranches: Branches feature MRs target — the live lines next to the protected ones.
_ownerHosts: Hosts of the company git whose tags, merges and protected branches only the owner touches (owner-actions). Default [] — no host is guarded. OWNER_GATE_HOSTS outranks it.
_shellPaths: A file under $HOME your shell sources for path variables; commands like `git -C $APP_ENGINE push` are resolved with it. Names must be plain shell names.
_freshness: git-freshness: the vault variable, the repository variables whose HEAD shifts are reported, a tracker file inside the vault whose edits are reported, and sync — local branches fast-forwarded to <remote>/<branch> after that remote fetches (only when no worktree holds them; ahead or diverged ones are left and reported). No sync block — no ref is moved.
_dataBoundary: Prod relations whose rows describe the system (configuration), not business data. Default [] — every prod row is a business row.
_vaultRel: Vault path relative to $HOME when the vault variable is unset.
_workDocs: Reminder to record an explanation as a work-doc: cwd — regex over the repository path, text — the whole reminder. No block — the reminder is silent.

workDocs.text: [work-docs reminder] This looks like important system behaviour. If it is an explanation grounded in code, record it as a work-doc, not only in chat.
